name: agentic-sdlc
description: AI-assisted SDLC pipelines for ANDROID development (Kotlin + Gradle) in Claude Code. Android Foundation is the centerpiece stack provider; framework plugins (Retrofit, Room, Dagger/Hilt, …) attach additively to the orchestrator-managed flow via the Stack Provider Pattern. The generic sdlc core owns the pipeline; providers register themselves via manifest.yaml profiles (kind: foundation | framework). Adapted from AratKruglik/claude-sdlc (MIT).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Optional runtime dependency. Richer reasoning in BA (brainstorming), QA (test-driven-development), and architect agents (verification-before-completion). Pipeline degrades gracefully without it.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Optional external dependency (official Anthropic). Hooks-based in-session security review. Pipeline runs without it; the security phase still does a full mobile (MASVS) review.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Platform-agnostic SDLC orchestrator with stack-provider auto-discovery. Provides the pipeline-orchestrator skill (generic phases, review-loops, parallel groups, workflow discovery across plugins, file_glob/nested detection) plus 5 cost-tiered fallback agents (BA Opus/high, Dev Sonnet/medium, QA Sonnet/medium with iteration cap, Sec Opus/high platform-neutral baseline, Docs Haiku/low). Commands: /sdlc:start, /sdlc:doctor, /sdlc:list-stacks, /sdlc:batch, /sdlc:security-init.

plugins.name: android-foundation
plugins.description: Android Foundation — the centerpiece stack provider (Kotlin + Gradle, aspect android, priority 300, auto-detected via Gradle-AND-Kotlin). Full specialized roster: android-ba (Opus), android-developer, android-reviewer, android-security (Opus, MASVS/MASTG), android-tester, android-qa, android-docs (Haiku), plus on-demand android-debugger/devops/cicd/aar. Plugin-resident rules, optional Obsidian vault (manage-vault skill), optional Android CLI advisory, ktlint/detekt + non-negotiable hooks. Carries pinned house rules (Coil3, Kermit, KSP, @Serializable routes, DataStore, Play Billing). Workflow android-feature: BA->Dev->Review(<->Dev x3)->[Security||Test]->QA->Docs, auto-selected on Android projects.

plugins.name: retrofit-plugin
plugins.description: Additive framework provider for Retrofit/OkHttp networking. Auto-detected from the Gradle version catalog / build files; enriches the `network` aspect (enriches_aspect: network) via manifest.yaml (kind: framework) with the retrofit-conventions skill, development + security phase-prompt injections, and R8/ProGuard keep rules. Ships NO agents — it specializes the existing development / security phase prompts. Reference implementation of the Framework Provider Pattern.

plugins.name: room-plugin
plugins.description: Additive framework provider for Room (androidx.room) persistence. Auto-detected by the orchestrator from the Gradle version catalog / build files; enriches the `persistence` aspect (enriches_aspect: persistence) via manifest.yaml (kind: framework) with the room-conventions skill, development + security phase-prompt injections (suspend/Flow DAOs, @Transaction, parameterized queries, migrations, KSP), and R8/ProGuard keep rules. Ships NO agents — it specializes the existing development / security phase prompts.

plugins.name: dagger-plugin
plugins.description: Additive framework provider for Dagger / Hilt dependency injection (com.google.dagger). Auto-detected by the orchestrator from the Gradle version catalog / build files; enriches the `di` aspect (enriches_aspect: di) via manifest.yaml (kind: framework) with the hilt-conventions skill, development + security phase-prompt injections (constructor injection, @Module/@InstallIn, @Binds over @Provides, deliberate scoping, KSP), and R8/ProGuard keep rules. Realizes the 'detect, don't impose' DI resolution: the foundation states the generic DI principle, this plugin adds Hilt/Dagger specifics only when detected. Ships NO agents.

plugins.name: workmanager-plugin
plugins.description: Additive framework provider for Android WorkManager deferrable background work (androidx.work). Auto-detected by the orchestrator from the Gradle version catalog / build files; enriches the `background` aspect (enriches_aspect: background) via manifest.yaml (kind: framework) with the workmanager-conventions skill, development + security phase-prompt injections (CoroutineWorker, unique enqueue + ExistingWorkPolicy, Constraints/backoff, WorkerFactory DI, idempotent doWork/Result, non-sensitive inputData, WorkInfo Flow), and R8/ProGuard keep rules. First provider of the `background` aspect. Ships NO agents — it specializes the existing development / security phase prompts.

plugins.name: koin-plugin
plugins.description: Additive framework provider for Koin dependency injection (io.insert-koin). Auto-detected by the orchestrator from the Gradle version catalog / build files; enriches the `di` aspect (enriches_aspect: di) via manifest.yaml (kind: framework) with the koin-conventions skill, development + security phase-prompt injections (module DSL, constructor get(), startKoin/androidContext, koinViewModel, deliberate scopes), and minimal R8/ProGuard notes. Coexists with dagger-plugin on the `di` aspect — only the detected provider activates. Ships NO agents — it specializes the existing development / security phase prompts.
